criteria.name: C1 · Program correctness / ความถูกต้องของโปรแกรม
criteria.description: Looks at the program's output matching the task.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: The program produces correct output for every task, including edge cases.

levels.label: Fair
levels.description: Output is correct on most tasks, but some cases fail — typically edge cases or unusual input.

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Output is wrong on several tasks, or the program only works for the simple cases.

levels.label: Fail
levels.description: The program does not run, or its output is wrong almost everywhere and does not match the task.

criteria.name: C2 · Code readability / ความอ่านง่ายของโค้ด
criteria.description: Looks at naming, formatting and comments in the code.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Names are meaningful, formatting is consistent, and comments are used where needed.

levels.label: Fair
levels.description: Mostly readable, but a few names say too little or the formatting drifts in places.

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Many names are unclear, indentation is uneven and there are almost no comments, so a reader must guess what the code does.

levels.label: Fail
levels.description: The code cannot be followed — arbitrary names, and no structure or formatting at all.

criteria.name: C3 · Error handling / การจัดการ Error
criteria.description: Looks at handling of bad input and unusual cases.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Bad input and unusual cases are handled sensibly; the program never stops unexpectedly.

levels.label: Fair
levels.description: Common bad input is handled, but a few unusual cases still stop the program or give an unclear message.

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Errors are handled in a few places only; badly formed input can still crash the program.

levels.label: Fail
levels.description: No error handling — even slightly wrong input stops the program.

criteria.name: C1 · Understanding of programming / ความเข้าใจแนวคิดการเขียนโปรแกรม
criteria.description: Looks at understanding of programming.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Answers on programming are correct and complete and show clear understanding.

levels.label: Fair
levels.description: Answers on programming are mostly correct, but some points are incomplete or slightly misunderstood.

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Only part of programming is understood; several core points are wrong or confused.

levels.label: Fail
levels.description: Almost none of the ideas asked about in programming are understood.

criteria.name: C2 · Answer accuracy / ความถูกต้องของคำตอบ
criteria.description: Looks at the accuracy of each answer.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Almost every answer is correct, with no major mistakes.

levels.label: Fair
levels.description: Most answers are correct, with a few small mistakes.

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Many answers are wrong, including basic ones.

levels.label: Fail
levels.description: Most answers are wrong or left blank.

criteria.name: C3 · Reasoning and explanation / การให้เหตุผลและอธิบายคำตอบ
criteria.description: Looks at the reasoning given with each answer.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Reasoning is clear, in order, and based on the right principles.

levels.label: Fair
levels.description: Reasoning is given for most answers, but some skip steps or do not name the principle.

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Reasoning is given for only some answers, and it is vague or unsound.

levels.label: Fail
levels.description: No reasoning — only bare answers.

criteria.name: C1 · Understanding of programming theory / ความเข้าใจทฤษฎีการเขียนโปรแกรม
criteria.description: Looks at understanding of the theory and principles of programming.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Theory and principles of programming are explained correctly, completely and coherently.

levels.label: Fair
levels.description: The theory of programming is mostly explained correctly, but some topics are missing or not connected.

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: The theory of programming is wrong or incomplete on several main topics.

levels.label: Fail
levels.description: The theory of programming that was asked about cannot be explained.

criteria.name: C2 · Applying and solving problems / การประยุกต์และการแก้โจทย์
criteria.description: Looks at applying the principles to solve problems.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Chooses suitable methods and applies the principles to both easy and complex problems.

levels.label: Fair
levels.description: Easy problems are solved correctly, but complex ones get an unsuitable method or are left unfinished.

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Only a few easy problems are solved, and the method is wrong for most.

levels.label: Fail
levels.description: The principles cannot be applied to solve the problems.

criteria.name: C3 · Accuracy of working and written answers / ความถูกต้องของการคำนวณและการเขียนตอบ
criteria.description: Looks at the accuracy of the working and the final answers.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Working is shown in full, the steps are correct, and the final answers are right.

levels.label: Fair
levels.description: Working is mostly shown, with small slips in some calculations or steps.

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Many steps are skipped, or calculation errors make several final answers wrong.

levels.label: Fail
levels.description: No working shown, and most final answers are wrong.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Answers and proofs are correct on every item, with no logical gaps.

levels.label: Fair
levels.description: Answers and proofs are mostly correct, with a small logical gap in some items.

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Proofs have logical gaps or skip key steps in several items, and several answers are wrong.

levels.label: Fail
levels.description: Answers and proofs are mostly wrong, or what is written is not a proof.

criteria.name: C2 · Reasoning steps / ขั้นตอนการให้เหตุผล
criteria.description: Looks at the clarity of the reasoning steps.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Reasoning is shown step by step, clearly, citing the theorems used.

levels.label: Fair
levels.description: Steps are shown in order for the most part, but some do not cite the theorem used.

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Steps jump around or are missing in many places, so a reader cannot follow.

levels.label: Fail
levels.description: No reasoning steps shown — only the answers.

criteria.name: C3 · Mathematical notation / การใช้สัญลักษณ์ทางคณิตศาสตร์

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Notation and writing conventions are correct and consistent.

levels.label: Fair
levels.description: Notation is mostly correct, with a mix-up or an inconsistency here and there.

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Notation is wrong or inconsistent in many places, so the meaning has to be guessed.

levels.label: Fail
levels.description: Notation is so wrong that the mathematics cannot be read.

levels.label: Fail
levels.description: No simplification, or the simplification breaks the circuit.

levels.label: Fail
levels.description: No simulation, and no record of any verification.

criteria.name: C1 · Understanding of computer architecture / ความเข้าใจแนวคิดสถาปัตยกรรมคอมพิวเตอร์
criteria.description: Looks at understanding of computer architecture.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Answers on computer architecture are correct and complete and show clear understanding.

levels.label: Fair
levels.description: Answers on computer architecture are mostly correct, but some points are incomplete or slightly misunderstood.

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Only part of computer architecture is understood; several core points are wrong or confused.

levels.label: Fail
levels.description: Almost none of the ideas asked about in computer architecture are understood.

criteria.name: C2 · Answer accuracy / ความถูกต้องของคำตอบ
criteria.description: Looks at the accuracy of each answer.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Almost every answer is correct, with no major mistakes.

levels.label: Fair
levels.description: Most answers are correct, with a few small mistakes.

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Many answers are wrong, including basic ones.

levels.label: Fail
levels.description: Most answers are wrong or left blank.

criteria.name: C3 · Reasoning and explanation / การให้เหตุผลและอธิบายคำตอบ
criteria.description: Looks at the reasoning given with each answer.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Reasoning is clear, in order, and based on the right principles.

levels.label: Fair
levels.description: Reasoning is given for most answers, but some skip steps or do not name the principle.

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Reasoning is given for only some answers, and it is vague or unsound.

levels.label: Fail
levels.description: No reasoning — only bare answers.

criteria.name: C1 · Understanding of computer architecture theory / ความเข้าใจทฤษฎีสถาปัตยกรรมคอมพิวเตอร์
criteria.description: Looks at understanding of the theory and principles of computer architecture.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Theory and principles of computer architecture are explained correctly, completely and coherently.

levels.label: Fair
levels.description: The theory of computer architecture is mostly explained correctly, but some topics are missing or not connected.

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: The theory of computer architecture is wrong or incomplete on several main topics.

levels.label: Fail
levels.description: The theory of computer architecture that was asked about cannot be explained.

criteria.name: C2 · Applying and solving problems / การประยุกต์และการแก้โจทย์
criteria.description: Looks at applying the principles to solve problems.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Chooses suitable methods and applies the principles to both easy and complex problems.

levels.label: Fair
levels.description: Easy problems are solved correctly, but complex ones get an unsuitable method or are left unfinished.

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Only a few easy problems are solved, and the method is wrong for most.

levels.label: Fail
levels.description: The principles cannot be applied to solve the problems.

criteria.name: C3 · Accuracy of working and written answers / ความถูกต้องของการคำนวณและการเขียนตอบ
criteria.description: Looks at the accuracy of the working and the final answers.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Working is shown in full, the steps are correct, and the final answers are right.

levels.label: Fair
levels.description: Working is mostly shown, with small slips in some calculations or steps.

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Many steps are skipped, or calculation errors make several final answers wrong.

levels.label: Fail
levels.description: No working shown, and most final answers are wrong.
